scope: 19 thin normal home arenas from the 2026-27 NBA/NHL concessions audit.

method.production: Read-only inventory captured 2026-10-26. No production writes in this pass.
method.sources: Official arena or team pages first, then operator releases, then current local media. 2025 and older pages are labeled and are not treated as 2026-27.
method.staleRule: An existing row is STALE_REVIEW only with positive evidence it ended. Absence from a source is not enough.
method.skipRule: Generic soda, water, beer, chips, popcorn, peanuts, and plain pretzels are SKIP.
method.sharedBuildings: TD Garden, United Center, Xfinity Mobile Arena, and Crypto.com Arena were researched once.
